Deployment diagrams help developers visualise the software to hardware 
configuration (Lucidchart, n.d.); in this project, it clarifies how different AWS 
services work together, and which stacks define which services. The deployment 
diagrams Figure 50 to Figure 52, depict the applications architecture, detailing 
the integration of AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, ECS and EventBridge; and how 
they interact with one another. 
4.9 Creation of a Sample Lesson 
The creation of the sample lesson for GCSE biology on eukaryotic and 
prokaryotic cells was designed to follow the principle and guidance set out 
(Brame, 2016). The lesson had the author talking in an personal tone at a 
relatively fast pace, with individual videos lasting ~40 seconds. These video 
lengths aimed to ensure the videos did not exceed one minute as recommend by 
(Zaveri, 2023). The choice of lesson was to ensure that no prior knowledge is 
needed, hence the first lesson on the AQA course was selected. 
The lesson was divided into four main sections: "What is a eukaryotic cell?", 
"What is a eukaryotic cell made up of?", "What is a prokaryotic cell?", and "What 
are prokaryotic cells made up of?". Each section is designed to build upon the 
learning from the previous video.
